missed_quiet_win.sub_axis: Type of quiet winning resource missed

consensus_subgroups.name: Forgot to Queen
consensus_subgroups.desc: A pawn promotion to queen was available but overlooked.

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed Pawn Breakthrough
consensus_subgroups.desc: A quiet pawn advance or breakthrough winning material or creating a passer was missed.

consensus_subgroups.name: Endgame Sleepwalking
consensus_subgroups.desc: A winning endgame technique or king maneuver was available but the player drifted passively.

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed Piece Invasion
consensus_subgroups.desc: A quiet piece maneuver or invasion into a dominant square was overlooked.

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed Tactical Shot
consensus_subgroups.desc: A concrete but non-forcing tactic (trap, winning capture, or combination) was available but unseen.

passive_play.sub_axis: What concrete action was ignored while playing passively

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed the Winning Capture
consensus_subgroups.desc: A clear tactical capture was available but the player made an aimless move instead.

consensus_subgroups.name: Shuffled Pieces Going Nowhere
consensus_subgroups.desc: Moved pieces back and forth without purpose when the position demanded a concrete plan.

consensus_subgroups.name: Blind to Checkmate
consensus_subgroups.desc: Failed to see a mating attack (delivering or preventing) while making routine moves.

consensus_subgroups.name: Autopilot Development
consensus_subgroups.desc: Played textbook developing or routine moves when the position required a specific concrete action.

consensus_subgroups.name: Drifted in a Won Position
consensus_subgroups.desc: Had a decisive advantage but made passive moves instead of converting decisively.

missed_hanging_piece.sub_axis: target piece × capturing mechanism/motif × move played instead

consensus_subgroups.name: Queen Blindness
consensus_subgroups.desc: An enemy queen was hanging but the player failed to capture it.

consensus_subgroups.name: Sleepwalking King
consensus_subgroups.desc: In the endgame, the king could have captured an adjacent hanging piece but walked past it.

consensus_subgroups.name: Pawn-Take Blindness
consensus_subgroups.desc: A pawn could have captured a free piece but the capture was ignored.

consensus_subgroups.name: Autopilot Developer
consensus_subgroups.desc: Player made a developing or routine move instead of capturing a hanging piece.

consensus_subgroups.name: Diagonal Blindspot
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a capture along a diagonal line (bishop or queen geometry).

consensus_subgroups.name: Generic Piece Blindness
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a free piece that doesn't fit the other specific patterns.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Queen Dropper
consensus_subgroups.desc: Left the queen undefended or walked it into a capture, unforced.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Rook Gifter
consensus_subgroups.desc: Rook left or moved to an undefended square where it could be taken.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Minor Piece Abandoner
consensus_subgroups.desc: Knight or bishop left en prise with no compensation or recapture.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Pawn Forgetter
consensus_subgroups.desc: Pawn left undefended and lost for nothing, often in a quiet position.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Exchange Dodger
consensus_subgroups.desc: Ignored a forced exchange or recapture, leaving own piece hanging instead.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Opening Overreacher
consensus_subgroups.desc: Played an ambitious or autopilot opening move that left a piece undefended too early.

consensus_subgroups.name: The Sleepwalker
consensus_subgroups.desc: Made a quiet or passive move elsewhere while an own piece was already hanging.

pointless_check.sub_axis: Checking piece type and consequence (piece suicides, defense abandoned, or winning check missed)

consensus_subgroups.name: Suicidal Queen Check
consensus_subgroups.desc: Queen gives a pointless check and is immediately captured for nothing.

consensus_subgroups.name: Rook Check Hangs Itself
consensus_subgroups.desc: Rook delivers a futile check and is left en prise with no compensation.

consensus_subgroups.name: Knight/Bishop Check Into Capture
consensus_subgroups.desc: A minor piece checks but lands on a square where it is simply taken.

consensus_subgroups.name: Check Abandons the Fort
consensus_subgroups.desc: The checking move removes a defender from a critical task, leaving another piece or square unprotected.

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed the Winning Check
consensus_subgroups.desc: A strong forcing check was available but the player either checked with the wrong piece or played a weaker move instead.

endgame_technique.sub_axis: Endgame technique error type: which piece was misplayed and what decisive action was missed

consensus_subgroups.name: King Wandered Off
consensus_subgroups.desc: King moved to the wrong square or took a poor path, failing to support or oppose passed pawns

consensus_subgroups.name: Lazy Rook
consensus_subgroups.desc: Rook remained passive or poorly placed when an active rook move was needed

consensus_subgroups.name: Pushed Pawn Too Soon
consensus_subgroups.desc: Advanced a pawn prematurely, weakening it or losing a tempo in a critical race

consensus_subgroups.name: Forgot to Push
consensus_subgroups.desc: Failed to advance a passed or candidate pawn when the position demanded it

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed the Kill Shot
consensus_subgroups.desc: Overlooked a winning capture, promotion, or decisive simplification that would have ended the game

consensus_subgroups.name: Promotion Fumbler
consensus_subgroups.desc: Mishandled the promotion sequence—wrong square, wrong piece, or missed queening tactic

consensus_subgroups.name: Ducked the Queen Trade
consensus_subgroups.desc: Declined a necessary queen exchange, leaving the queen tension unresolved.

consensus_subgroups.name: Bishop Staring Contest
consensus_subgroups.desc: Left bishop-vs-bishop (or bishop-vs-piece) tension frozen without resolving the exchange.

consensus_subgroups.name: Pawn Tension Left to Rot
consensus_subgroups.desc: Ignored pawn tension (captures, breaks, or trades) that needed immediate resolution.

consensus_subgroups.name: Rook Trade Ducked
consensus_subgroups.desc: Refused or overlooked a rook exchange on an open file or contested line.

consensus_subgroups.name: Quiet Move While Piece Hangs
consensus_subgroups.desc: Played a passive/quiet move while a piece or pawn was left en prise or under unresolved attack.

consensus_subgroups.name: Knight Swap Blindness
consensus_subgroups.desc: Left a knight capture or knight exchange unresolved when it demanded attention.

missed_winning_tactic.sub_axis: Tactical Motif / Piece Involved in Missed Tactic

consensus_subgroups.name: Knight Fork Blind
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a winning knight fork that would have won material

consensus_subgroups.name: Pawn Breakthrough Missed
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a decisive pawn break or pawn advance winning material or creating unstoppable threats

consensus_subgroups.name: Rook Invasion Missed
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a winning rook penetration into the opponent's position

consensus_subgroups.name: Queen Trap Missed
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a tactic that wins the opponent's queen or traps a major piece

consensus_subgroups.name: Bishop Diagonal Missed
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a winning bishop tactic along a diagonal (pin, skewer, or discovery)

consensus_subgroups.name: Blind to Captures
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a simple winning capture that was available, overlooking hanging or underdefended pieces

consensus_subgroups.name: Missed Forcing Blow
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a decisive forcing move (check, threat, or intermediate move) that wins material

consensus_subgroups.name: Sleepwalked Past a Win
consensus_subgroups.desc: Played a quiet or passive move while a clear winning tactic was available, general tactical blindness

consensus_subgroups.name: Fork Knight
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a knight fork or knight check that wins material or delivers mate.

consensus_subgroups.name: Mate Blind
consensus_subgroups.desc: A forced checkmate was available but a quieter or non-mating move was played.

consensus_subgroups.name: Greed Goggles
consensus_subgroups.desc: Captured material (greedy move) instead of playing a stronger forcing check or mate.

consensus_subgroups.name: Queen Thunderbolt
consensus_subgroups.desc: Overlooked a powerful queen check or queen-delivered mating attack.

consensus_subgroups.name: Diagonal Dagger
consensus_subgroups.desc: Missed a bishop sacrifice, discovery, or diagonal check/mate motif.

consensus_subgroups.name: Rook Hammer
consensus_subgroups.desc: Failed to use a rook check, back-rank mate, or rook-lift attack.

consensus_subgroups.name: Check Reflex Failure
consensus_subgroups.desc: General failure to consider any forcing check (no specific piece/motif); quiet-move drift.

premature_aggression.sub_axis: piece/target pattern of the unsound aggression

consensus_subgroups.name: Yolo Nxf7 Sacrifice
consensus_subgroups.desc: Unsound piece sacrifice on f7 (or f2) that doesn't yield sufficient compensation

consensus_subgroups.name: Knight Jumped Into Thin Air
consensus_subgroups.desc: Knight lunges aggressively into enemy territory only to be captured with no real threat

consensus_subgroups.name: Flashy Check Hangs Everything
consensus_subgroups.desc: Showy check that ignores defensive resources and leaves own material hanging

consensus_subgroups.name: Promoted Into Enemy Fire
consensus_subgroups.desc: Premature or greedy promotion that walks the new piece straight into capture

consensus_subgroups.name: Bishop Overreach
consensus_subgroups.desc: Bishop lunges to an aggressive square where it's trapped or captured by a pawn

consensus_subgroups.name: Greedy Grab Gets Punished
consensus_subgroups.desc: Impulsive material grab that loses tempo or hangs a piece to a tactical reply

consensus_subgroups.name: Premature Pawn Shove
consensus_subgroups.desc: Aggressive early pawn push that weakens own position without creating real threats

greedy_capture.sub_axis: Greedy piece type self-destructing + missed-threat/abandonment motif

consensus_subgroups.name: Queen Kamikaze
consensus_subgroups.desc: Queen captures material but lands on a square where it is lost to recapture or trap.

consensus_subgroups.name: Rook Into Recapture
consensus_subgroups.desc: Rook grabs material but steps into an immediately losing recapture or dead-end square.

consensus_subgroups.name: Minor Piece Self-Destructs
consensus_subgroups.desc: Bishop or knight captures greedily and is immediately lost or trapped.

consensus_subgroups.name: Wrong Target
consensus_subgroups.desc: Captures an inferior piece/pawn when a stronger tactical shot (fork, skewer, deflection) was available.

consensus_subgroups.name: Capture Abandons Guard
consensus_subgroups.desc: The capturing piece leaves its post, abandoning defense of a more valuable ally or critical square.

consensus_subgroups.name: Passive Neglect Drops Piece
consensus_subgroups.desc: Greedy capture is a slow/quiet move that ignores the opponent's active threat, hanging material elsewhere.

consensus_subgroups.name: Greed Ignores Mate
consensus_subgroups.desc: Grabs material while a mating attack (for either side) was the real priority.
